name: disk-reclaim
description: Recover disk space on a macOS developer laptop without losing anyone's work: read the APFS container, run a read-only census that classifies every large path, ask the other live Claude Code sessions what is safe to delete, record every decision, and remove only through a ledger-gated executor that refuses undecided or owned paths. Ships a SessionStart low-disk nudge and a self-detaching census.
